headline: Banxico Minutes Reveal Inflation Concerns as Mexican Peso Weakens
summary: Bank of Mexico minutes showed policy makers divided over currency depreciation risks after the peso fell 2.26% in a single session and crossed 19 per US dollar.
why: Banxico is Mexico's central bank responsible for monetary policy and inflation management.

impacts.name: Mexican Peso
impacts.why: The Mexican peso depreciated past 19 per dollar following central bank minutes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Uncertainty around Banxico's policy rate response to currency weakness pushed the peso lower.
